info.name: ClaimPilot API — Video Demo
info.description: Runnable happy-path tests for a ClaimPilot video demo. Run the requests in order, or use Collection Runner. Tokens and IDs are saved automatically as collection variables.

exec: pm.test('API is healthy', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Adjuster login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Adjuster token and role are returned', function () { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.roles).to.include('Adjuster'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('adjusterToken', body.token);
pm.test('Current user is the adjuster', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().roles).to.include('Adjuster'); });

item.name: 4. List seeded claims and select version-trap claim

exec: pm.test('Seeded claims are available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });
const claim = pm.response.json().find(c => c.claimNumber === 'CLAIM-2023-001');
pm.test('2023 version-trap claim is seeded', function () { pm.expect(claim, 'CLAIM-2023-001').to.exist; });
if (claim) pm.collectionVariables.set('versionTrapClaimId', claim.id);

pm.test('The selected claim is the 2023 AUT-2022 scenario', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.claimNumber).to.eql('CLAIM-2023-001'); pm.expect(body.policyNumber).to.eql('AUT-2022'); });
pm.test('Claim intake returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('New claim has an identifier and submitted status', function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('Submitted'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('createdClaimId', body.id);

pm.test('Policy Q&A returns a safe response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.answer).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.refused).to.be.a('boolean'); });
pm.test('Adjudication request completed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const stream = pm.response.text();
pm.test('SSE includes a completed run', function () { pm.expect(stream).to.include('event: run_complete'); });
const match = stream.match(/event: run_complete\s+data: (.*)/);

if (match) { const envelope = JSON.parse(match[1]); const run = JSON.parse(envelope.payload); pm.collectionVariables.set('runId', run.Id || run.id || envelope.run_id); if (run.ApprovalItems && run.ApprovalItems.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('approvalItemId', run.ApprovalItems[0].Id || run.ApprovalItems[0].id); }
pm.test('Supervisor login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Supervisor role is returned', function () { pm.expect(body.roles).to.include('Supervisor'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('supervisorToken', body.token);
pm.test('Supervisor can access the pending review queue', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
const items = pm.response.json(); if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('approvalItemId') && items.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('approvalItemId', items[0].id);
pm.test('Supervisor statistics are available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Claim audit entries are returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
